description.value:
Trigger An hour passes after the PCs fall asleep in Jona's proximity

Effect Blood and gory limbs rise up to flood and clutch. Each PC must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:22] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

stealth.details: (expert) to notice the blood welling up and "wake up" in the nightmare

details.description: A flood of blood bubbles up out of the ground, along with dozens of grasping arms that try to drag sleeping victims down into the gory deep.
details.disable: @Check[religion|dc:23] to draw upon your faith to weaken the haunt, @Check[occultism|dc:20] or @Check[perception|dc:26] to recognize tells that suggest this is all just a nightmare and to use lucid dreaming techniques to minimize the threat; three total successes are required to disable the haunt
details.reset: The haunt deactivates after 5 rounds. While the PCs then wake as detailed above, until the haunt is disabled, it resets and can trigger again the next time the PCs and Jona sleep.
details.routine: (1 action) The haunt tries to choke and drown the PCs in blood. The experience is harrowing and violent, and while the threat is all in the PCs' minds, it can still kill them. All affected PCs take @Damage[3d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:22|basic] save). A PC who fails this saving throw also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} for 24 hours (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 24 hours on a critical failure).
